reader2StaticAuthority.policy: Existing canonical static components and visual geometry are frozen. This packet supplies runtime identity and interaction evidence; it does not authorize redraw.

routeFamily.figmaPrimaryVisualStates: Reader Control Home + seven canonical overlay states + four full panel states. immersive-reading is the runtime no-control surface and continuity origin.
routeFamily.crosswalkRule: Compatibility routes preserve their local route and declaration-governed semantic-slot contract while sharing the canonical visual surface. Figma labels must not create replacement business routes or a second state owner.

semanticSlot.dataControlToken: identity-only token; excluded from UiEvent schema and native enums

r2aInstrumentation.conditionalInventoryPolicy: The declaration set includes route aliases and conditional/full-state controls that are not simultaneously rendered. Every rendered primary-route set was verified with zero duplicate controlKey and zero empty chapter business key on Phone and Tablet.
r2aInstrumentation.chapterIdentityPolicy: Fixture chapters carry explicit chapterKey values. Reader directory rows and chapter downloads emit data-action plus data-reader-chapter-key; ordinal, selector hash and display-label fallback are prohibited.
r2aInstrumentation.unknownIdentityPolicy: Unknown routes, missing selectors and ambiguous selectors fail closed and do not receive data-control-key.

productionWiring: Every primary/compatibility route commit updates the reader-runtime owner without replacing the existing UiEvent owner.
Page turn, chapter jump, TTS start and session stop update both the established runtime state and the contract owner.
Both initial render and pagination rerender reapply fail-closed identity instrumentation.
guards: unknown route, page direction and chapter key return the same state
TTS and auto-page share one mutually exclusive session owner
duplicate content/TOC request starts return duplicate
stale async completions do not change settled state
interrupt cancels pending requests, stops sessions and advances interruptSequence
ariaAndFocus: immersive reading hotzones remain native buttons with explicit names
role=button chapter rows remain keyboard reachable by Enter and Space
chapter downloads expose aria-busy and aria-disabled
overlay/module/full-panel triggers receive deterministic data-restore-focus markers
all stamped controls without an accessible name receive their explicit contract label

viewports: Tablet policy via 900x1000 outer viewport / 760x960 internal canvas

figmaCrosswalkRequired.mode: F0 read and crosswalk first; static redraw is prohibited unless a new Design Delta is explicitly approved.

admission.expectedFigmaTransaction: Crosswalk and evidence update against the frozen Reader 2 canonical static source; no visual mutation when no drift exists.
